an6.14:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi,
an6.14:1.3: “āvuso”ti, kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an6.14:2.1: tathā tathā āvuso bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti, yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
an6.14:2.2: kathañcāvuso. bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti. yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
an6.14:3.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu kammārāmo hoti kammarato kammārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhassārāmo hoti bhassarato bhassārāmataṃ anuyutto, niddā rāmo hoti niddārato niddārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṅgaṇikārāmo hoti saṅgaṇikārato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṃsaggārāmo hoti saṃsaggarato saṃsaggārāmataṃ anuyutto, papañcārāmo hoti papañcarato papañcārāmataṃ anuyutto.
an6.14:3.2: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti, yathā yathā’ssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
an6.14:3.4: bhikkhu sakkāyābhirato na pahāsi sakkāyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.
an6.14:4.1: tathā tathāvuso bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
an6.14:4.2: kathañcāvuso bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti, yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
an6.14:5.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu na kammārāmo hoti na kammarato na kammārāmataṃ anuyutto, na bhassārāmo hoti na bhassarato na bhassārāmataṃ anuyutto, na niddārāmo hoti, na niddārato na niddārāmataṃ anuyutto, na saṅgaṇikārāmo hoti na saṅgaṇikārato na saṅgaṇikā rāmataṃ anuyutto, na saṃsaggārāmo hoti na saṃsaggarato na saṃsaggārāmataṃ anuyutto, na papañcārāmo hoti na papañcarato na papañcārāmataṃ anuyutto.
an6.14:5.2: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu tathā tathāssa vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
an6.14:5.4: bhikkhu nibbānābhirato pahāsi sakkāyaṃ sammādukkhassa antakiriyāyāti.
